title: Reading Drill — Comparing Watering Records in a Nursery
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing Watering Records in a Nursery
passages.body:
**A** Two nursery teams kept separate reports on seedling trays. One team measured water in cups, while the other wrote down the number of minutes a sprinkler ran.

**B** Because the two records could not be directly compared, a supervisor put identical cups under the sprinkler to estimate the amount supplied per minute.

**C** On windy days some cups filled faster than others. The supervisor retained that difference in the results and advised the team to collect several readings rather than relying on a single cup.
